name: ZX_DATA_UPLOAD_DISCARD
description: This is an intermediate table used by the data upload program to temporarily hold the content from third party content providers not used by Fusion Tax.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_NAME
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: PROGRAM_APP_NAME
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: ZONE_GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Automatically populated.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE
columns.description: Type of rate. Valid values: 09, 10, 11, 12. 09 means sales tax. 10 means use tax. 11 means rental rate. 12 means lease rate.

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Code of the country to which the geography belongs. Must use two-letter ISO code. Example: United States is US. Use the Manage Tax Geographies task to identify valid values.

columns.name: STATE_JURISDICTION_CODE
columns.description: State jurisdiction code for creating concatenated jurisdiction code. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: COUNTY_JURISDICTION_CODE
columns.description: County jurisdiction code for creating concatenated jurisdiction code. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: CITY_JURISDICTION_CODE
columns.description: City jurisdiction code for creating concatenated jurisdiction code. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: COUNTRY_STATE_ABBREVIATION
columns.description: Abbreviation for country or state. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_NAME
columns.description: Primary name of the geography. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Effective from date. Date format: YYYY/MM/DD.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: Effective to date. Date format: YYYY/MM/DD.

columns.name: ZIP_BEGIN
columns.description: Lowest value in the zip code range. Must be a valid zip code. Free text field. Not validated. Applies only to US tax jurisdictions.

columns.name: ZIP_END
columns.description: Highest value in the zip code range. Must be a valid zip code. Free text field. Not validated. Applies only to US tax jurisdictions.

columns.name: JURISDICTION_SERIAL_NUMBER
columns.description: Indicates whether geography is inside or outside city limits. Valid values: 0, 1. 0 means outside city limits. 1 means inside city limits.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: CREATION_VERSION
columns.description: File version of the third party content provider in which this record was first introduced. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATION_VERSION
columns.description: File version of the third party content provider in which this record was last updated. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Valid values: CREATE, UPDATE, ERROR, NOCHANGE.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Error message.

columns.name: CHANGE_FLAG
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: process identifier that created or last updated the row. For Oracle Cloud implementations: Import Tax Configuration Content. For On-Premise implementations: Upload Tax Configuration Content

columns.name: GEO_DATA_PROVIDER
columns.description: Always use: Vertex. Format (upper versus lower case) determined by configuration.

columns.name: RENTAL_TAX_RATE
columns.description: Tax rate for rental tax from the content provider. Use the Manage Tax Rates task to view loaded rates.

columns.name: RENTAL_TAX_RATE_ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether rental tax rate is active. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: RENTAL_TAX_AUTHORITY_LEVEL
columns.description: Tax authority level that identifies rental tax rate. Valid values: STATE, COUNTY, CITY.

columns.name: USE_TAX_RATE
columns.description: Tax rate for use tax from the content provider.

columns.name: USE_TAX_RATE_ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether use tax rate is active. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: USE_TAX_AUTHORITY_LEVEL
columns.description: Tax authority level. Valid values: STATE, COUNTY, CITY.

columns.name: LEASE_TAX_RATE
columns.description: Tax rate for lease tax.

columns.name: LEASE_TAX_RATE_ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether lease tax rate is active. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: LEASE_TAX_AUTHORITY_LEVEL
columns.description: Tax authority level. Valid values: STATE, COUNTY, CITY.

columns.name: SALES_TAX_RATE
columns.description: Tax rate for sales tax.

columns.name: SALES_TAX_RATE_ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether sales tax rate is active. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: SALES_TAX_AUTHORITY_LEVEL
columns.description: Tax authority level. Valid values: STATE, COUNTY, CITY.

columns.name: MULTIPLE_PARENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether geography has more than one parent. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: PRIMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Check box that identifies primary geographies. Valid values: Y, N. Y is used to create geographies and jurisdictions. N is used to create geographies without jurisdictions.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.
